rejection_summary: Tuner (2025/2026 release cycle): strong crime/heist execution but the complete story is primarily a character-driven safecracking and romance/crime drama, with too little mystery, investigation and progressive revelation to clear this Thriller profile's 62-point acceptance threshold.

The Shards (2026): revelation-cadence failure for this profile. The nine-episode season sustains suspicion around the Trawler but ends without identifying the killer; secrets and incidents accumulate, yet the central investigation withholds its defining answer and does not provide enough progressive payoff across the season to qualify.
